main_text.p: lium certaminum, & curarum beneuolentiam, atque purum affectum vicissim accipere? Quia prior adorauerat Pontifex Photium, prior illius curam egerat, prior beneuolentiam & purum affectum in Photium commonstrauerat, a Photio dignus habitus est & veneratione & cura & affectu: Si non id egisset, Photiana gratia, & affectu indignus iudicatus fuisset; & vixisset Romae inglorius, inhonorius, incuratus, neglectus. Quis non videt impudentiam Photij? quis non miratur Romanam inertiam, reliquorum Praesulum dementiam? Et credam ipse similia in confessu publico Praesulum celebrata?

Et considera[?] Lector. Synodus ista cogenda prorsus erat pro restitutione Photij expulsi, vt sicuti confessu publico eiectus fuerat, ita & publico decreto suo throno redderetur, quod videbatur magis ipsi Photio honorificum, sic enim iniustitia sibi facta apertius omnibus patuisset. Et nihilominus haec Synodus cogitur non pro illius restitutione, sed contra illius rebelles, & ab illo dissidentes. Ἐ″πʼ ἀρχῆς δὲ τῆς ὑμῶν παλαιό-[?] πτώσεως Φωτίου ἐπισκόπου, ἐάν τις εἰς ἀπ[?]οδόσεως [?] τῆς πάλιν, ὅλοι Χριστοῦ τοῦ ἀληθινοῦ Θεοφιλῆ τῇ κοινῇ πάντων κεφαλῇ κολλησθῶσι, ἐὰν εἰς ἐν

page.notes: The Greek paragraph is only partly legible on the scan, especially the first two lines and the middle of the paragraph. The Greek words marked [?] are best readings, and the wording of the passage is not certain. The Greek tail "ἐν" at the foot is the catchword, not part of the text. The Latin "considera" is doubtful: it could be "consldera" in print. The "E 4" signature is printed at the foot and is included in bottom_margin.
